description: This file implements the ProfileReader class which reads user profile information from the database, maps data models to API response models, and manages related logic such as follow status. It interacts with the database context, performs queries, and throws exceptions when profiles are not found.

classes.name: ProfileReader
classes.description: Class responsible for reading user profile data from the database, mapping it to API models, and determining follow status.

methods.name: ReadProfile
methods.description: Asynchronously reads a user's profile by username, includes follow status if a current user is available, and returns the profile wrapped in a ProfileEnvelope.
